info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Disputes-v4-spec
info.description: The Payments Dispute Management API provides a streamlined interface for listing and managing payment disputes within the payment processing system. This API enables organizations to retrieve comprehensive details about payment disputes, facilitating efficient resolution and tracking. Typical consumers include financial institutions and merchant services providers that handle payment operations, allowing them to effectively manage and address customer disputes. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their dispute resolution processes and improve customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of disputed payments.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all payments that have been marked as disputed. It provides a comprehensive view of all ongoing disputes, enabling users to review details and take necessary actions.

requestBody.description: Request body for the GET operation on the payments dispute endpoint. This body should contain the necessary parameters to retrieve the details of a specific payment dispute.
